scale.title: Severity Scale
scale.critical.desc: Nation-state scale botnet or major volumetric attack.
scale.high.desc: Coordinated botnet — consider geographic filtering or BGP RTBH.
scale.medium.desc: Amplified scanner or small-to-medium botnet activity.
remediation.title: Remediation
remediation.rateLimits.title: Per-endpoint rate limits
remediation.rateLimits.desc: Cap the RPS per-IP on the targeted path to drain the attack volume without blocking all traffic.
remediation.geoFilter.title: Geographic filtering
remediation.geoFilter.desc: If attacks originate from one region, restrict access via the GeoIP module or a CIDR block in the IP access list.
remediation.challenge.title: Challenge escalation
remediation.challenge.desc: Enable attack-mode on the targeted host to serve JS proof-of-work challenges to all visitors.
remediation.rtbh.title: BGP RTBH
remediation.rtbh.desc: For volumetric attacks, use BGP blackhole routing to drop traffic at the network edge.
